description: This file defines a React context and provider component for managing notes within the frontend of a note-taking application. It implements CRUD operations for notes, interacts with an API module, and uses authentication context to ensure secure access.

methods.name: NotesProvider
methods.description: React component that provides notes management context to children components, managing the state and CRUD operations.

methods.name: useNotes
methods.description: Custom hook that provides access to the notes context, ensuring it is used within a NotesProvider.
